previous_versions.body: As I said, I believe that it is is important to specifically mention multi-tenancy separation as it might require additional or more stringent controls compared to regular BOLA protection. I think [Jim's comment](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2060#issuecomment-2331769230) nicely illustrates the associated complexities :) We probably don't want to go into as much detail but I think it demonstrates the point.

I also believe that it is is important to specifically mention multi-tenancy separation as it might require additional or more stringent controls compared to regular BOLA protection.

[I suggested](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2033#issuecomment-2324157184):

> Verify that multi-tenant applications use cross-tenant controls to ensure user operations will never affect tenants which they do not have permissions to interact with.
